title: Look Twice Before You Answer: Memory-Space Visual Retracing for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 缓解多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的幻觉——即断言性生成图像中不存在的内容，且不需外部知识检索或额外微调
contributions.mechanism: 提出 MEMVR（Memory-space Visual Retracing）范式：把视觉 token 当作补充证据，通过 FFN 作为 'key-value memory' 在中间触发层重新注入 MLLM。架构无关、即插即用、单次常规推理
contributions.evaluation: 在多个 MLLM（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen-VL-Chat、GLM4V）与七类基准上评估，含 GPT-4o 评测；相比 VCD、OPERA 等对比解码，单次推理无额外时间开销
contributions.domain: 多模态大语言模型 / 幻觉缓解
contributions.source_quote: We propose MEMVR, a novel training-free hallucination mitigation paradigm that effectively alleviates hallucinations in MLLMs. In contrast to previous methods, which primarily focus on eliminating biases of language priors, MEMVR seeks to replenish question-relevant visual clues towards more evidential responses, which signifies the other side of the coin.

contributions.purpose: 让视觉重描在模型对视觉记忆不确定时被触发，并给出理论依据
contributions.mechanism: 设计动态早熟层注入策略（dynamic premature layer injection）：按各层输出不确定性（熵）触发视觉重描；并从信息论视角理论证明视觉重描能降低幻觉
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论证明为主；辅以不确定性分析（32 层 LLaVA-1.5-7B，早退层输出分布不确定性，Finding #1/#2：关键实体 token 不确定性高且动态）；消融显示动态重描优于固定层
contributions.source_quote: We design a dynamic premature layer injection strategy with visual retracing in MLLMs ... Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that visual retracing can effectively diminish hallucinations from an information-theoretic perspective.

contributions.purpose: 实证证明 MEMVR 在缓解幻觉与提升通用感知/认知能力上有效且高效
contributions.mechanism: 在 POPE、CHAIR、MME 等幻觉基准及通用基准上综合实验与消融（注入比例 a、视觉特征加高斯噪声等）
contributions.evaluation: POPE 上平均最高 +7.0% accuracy、+7.5% F1（A-OKVQA，Random/Popular/Adversarial）；CHAIR_I 相比原始 LLaVA-1.5-7B 最高改善 15.6%；MME 子集一致提升；单次推理无额外时间开销
contributions.domain: 多模态大语言模型 / 幻觉基准
contributions.source_quote: our MEMVR presents robust effects. The performance of MEMVR surpasses the baseline results by large margins, i.e., average up to +7.0% accuracy and +7.5% F1 score on A-OKVQA dataset ... our MEMVR achieves up to 15.6% improvements on CHAIR_I compared with vanilla LLaVA-1.5-7B.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Different from visual contrastive decoding strategies that alleviate hallucinations by diminishing language priors (Leng et al., 2024; Qu et al., 2024; Park et al., 2024), we propose a novel Memory-space Visual Retracing (MEMVR) method that mitigates hallucinations through supplementing visual evidence, akin to the two sides of a coin.
Informed by the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting (Zhai et al., 2023) in MLLMs, we argue that the capabilities of LLMs to comprehend and memorize different modalities are quite distinct.

CD-based approaches (Chuang et al., 2023; Leng et al., 2024) adjust the decoding distribution to mitigate hallucinations, but it does not consistently improve performance. Compared with them, our MEMVR stands as 'a paradigm of effectiveness and efficiency' in hallucination mitigation, effortlessly enhancing performance without extra training.

notes: 主基调为正向改进。作者自陈局限（limitations 节，属 caveat 而非负结果）：MEMVR 对 MLLM 架构差异敏感，注入比例 a、早熟层等超参需逐模型调优，限制可扩展性；MEMVR 对视觉特征质量敏感——加高斯噪声后感知/认知分数随噪声升高而下降，高噪声下性能显著跌落。批评 CD 类方法 'does not consistently improve performance'。（该论文 decision=reject）
